channels.label: ROC_LOC

channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 is referenced to the contralateral ear A1, equivalent to the C4-M1 derivation.

channels.label: EMG1_EMG2
channels.reason: Bipolar EMG1-EMG2 with a 10-100 Hz filter is the chin EMG.

channels.label: DX1_DX2
channels.reason: Italian DX means right; this is an EMG transducer with a 10-100 Hz filter, i.e. right leg (tibialis) EMG.

channels.label: SX1_SX2
channels.reason: Italian SX means left; this is an EMG transducer with a 10-100 Hz filter, i.e. left leg (tibialis) EMG.

channels.label: F8_T4
channels.reason: Bipolar temporal EEG derivation F8-T4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: F7_T3
channels.reason: Bipolar temporal EEG derivation F7-T3 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: Italian torace means thorax; this is the respiratory effort band, low-pass filtered at 3 Hz.

channels.label: SAO2
channels.reason: Oxygen saturation in % from the oximeter.

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Microphone with a Sound transducer records snoring.

channels.label: HR
channels.reason: Heart rate in BPM from the oximeter.

channels.label: STAT
channels.reason: Oximeter status channel, not a physiological signal.
